facts.fact: Sudan's Telecommunications and Postal Regulatory Authority says the first phase of its Ibsar Project, computer and internet training for visually impaired and low-vision people, was inaugurated on 12 December 2017.

Sudan's Persons with Disability National Act 2017, in force on signature, provides for sign language with on-screen text in media programmes and for building designs that enable access to electronic services.

facts.fact: A journal study assessed seven Sudanese academic, governmental and service websites against WCAG 2.1 AA using WAVE, axe DevTools and Lighthouse, finding Lighthouse scores of 76 to 88 and critical barriers on all sites.
